providers.name: Tenpin Exeter · bowling party
providers.basis: Exeter advertised price · Saturdays & Sundays, subject to availability
providers.included: Bowling, pizza and fries, unlimited squash and a goody bag for the birthday child. This is a party package, not private hire of the whole venue.
providers.check: Confirm the final Exeter quote, guest limit, time slot and dietary needs. The terms request two adults aged 18+ per four children; online bookings are paid in full. Bring your own cake: the current party FAQ says staff cannot present it. Confirm serving arrangements and cancellation terms before paying. The 36-person online booking limit is not a verified party capacity.
providers.instagram_note: National Tenpin account linked by the official Exeter page; not an Exeter-only account.

source_review.qualification: Use the specific party page’s 4–13 age guidance, not the broader under-16 wording in general terms. The current FAQ does not offer staff cake presentation, unlike older indexed copy. Maximum party capacity and live slots remain unconfirmed. No provider contact or booking was made.
source_review.image_rights: No photo reproduction permission confirmed. Link to official venue photographs only.

providers.name: iPlay Exeter
providers.basis: 6 children aged 1–7 + 6 adults
providers.included: Lunch boxes, cupcakes, juice and water. Table reserved for 1 hour 40 minutes.
providers.check: Extra children £10.95; extra adults £2. Adult seating is not guaranteed. The provider says it cannot cater for all nut allergies; discuss dietary needs directly.
providers.instagram_note: No confirmed Instagram link found; do not guess a handle or substitute iBounce without confirmation.

providers.name: Wonderland Play
providers.basis: Minimum 5 children; choose the Exeter venue
providers.included: The listed package includes soft play, party food, private party-room time, set-up and room clean-up.
providers.check: Confirm suitable ages, the complete timetable and the final Exeter booking quote. The previous design's £54.75 starting price is not reused.
providers.instagram_note: Shared centres account; tag and name the Exeter branch accurately.

providers.name: St Sidwell’s Point
providers.basis: Soft play guidance: ages 3–8
providers.included: Soft play party arrangements, with party food available as an add-on.
providers.check: Ask about guest limits, duration, food, supervision and the total price. This entry describes soft play, not a verified pool-party package.
providers.instagram_note: Exeter Leisure's organisation-wide account, not a separate St Sidwell’s party account.

providers.name: Park Hub · ParkLife Heavitree
providers.basis: Plus a £50 refundable deposit, subject to conditions
providers.included: Kitchenette, tables, chairs and access to the community garden. The café is not included in hall hire.
providers.check: Take rubbish home and leave the room clean. The café is not included. Confirm the safe layout for your children and adults, external food and any supplier access.
providers.instagram_note: ParkLife's community account; do not confuse it with Exeter Community Centre's Heavitree Room.

hire_facts.note: The published party rate covers a 3-hour booking, not a verified minimum or maximum hire. This allows a 2-hour party plus 30 minutes each for setting up and clearing away.
hire_facts.included: Kitchenette, tables, chairs and access to the community garden. The café is not included in hall hire.
hire_facts.unknown_reason: No explicit minimum or maximum booking duration found. 8am–10pm is an operating window, not a maximum hire duration.

providers.name: Exeter Community Centre
providers.basis: Children’s party suitability not yet confirmed
providers.included: Rooms can be hired by the hour, half day or day. Catering can be discussed separately; children's-party suitability remains unconfirmed.
providers.check: General room hire is confirmed, but permission for a children's birthday party, the suitable room, current tariff, outside food and kitchen access still need confirmation. Do not present this as a confirmed children's party venue.
providers.instagram_note: Official centre account. Party-booking eligibility remains a separate unresolved question.

hire_facts.note: Choose a room and confirm children's-party permission before relying on any capacity or hire limit. Hourly, half-day and day pricing does not establish a booking minimum or maximum.
hire_facts.included: Rooms can be hired by the hour, half day or day. Catering can be discussed separately; children's-party suitability remains unconfirmed.
hire_facts.unknown_reason: No room selected and no current children's-party agreement. Brochure capacities for a particular room cannot be assigned to the whole centre.

providers.name: Wonford Community & Learning Centre
providers.basis: £67.50 for members; advertised for under-16 parties
providers.included: Main Hall party slots run at weekends between 9am and 7pm, subject to availability. Free parking is advertised. Ask how set-up and clear-up fit within your booked slot.
providers.check: Confirm kitchen access, food, capacity and whether set-up and clear-up must fit within the slot. Bouncy castles are booked separately with external suppliers; the centre requires insurance evidence.
providers.instagram_note: Linked from the official centre website.

hire_facts.note: The 2-hour minimum is for standard Friday-night/weekend sole-use hire. The children's-party price shown is a separate 3-hour offer; longer bookings use the full hourly rate. Capacity includes children and adults; agree your party layout.
hire_facts.included: Main Hall party slots run at weekends between 9am and 7pm, subject to availability. Free parking is advertised. Ask how set-up and clear-up fit within your booked slot.
hire_facts.unknown_reason: No explicit maximum booking duration published. The special offer's 3 hours is not a maximum. The Phoenix Suite is stated to be unsuitable for children's parties and is not used here.

providers.name: The Beacon
providers.offer: Jaffa Cake or Hobnob Hall hire
providers.basis: Public hall + kitchen guide: from £23.50/hour for community/charity use
providers.included: Jaffa Cake and Hobnob halls have kitchen facilities, tables and chairs described on the party-hire page. Confirm the private-party total and inclusions.
providers.check: Confirm the private-party tariff and outside-food rules. The page still carries a notice that soft play has been unavailable since 1 September 2025; do not count soft play as available without confirmation.
providers.instagram_note: Official website-linked community centre account.

hire_facts.note: Confirm the chosen hall — Jaffa Cake or Hobnob — and its permitted party layout. General opening/closing times do not establish a maximum booking length.
hire_facts.included: Jaffa Cake and Hobnob halls have kitchen facilities, tables and chairs described on the party-hire page. Confirm the private-party total and inclusions.
hire_facts.unknown_reason: Individual room pages returned HTTP 429; no repeated retries or inferred occupancy. Terms require the designated occupancy to be followed but do not supply a number or an explicit minimum/maximum duration.

providers.name: Longdown Village Hall
providers.basis: Personal/non-profit Main Hall rate; 3-hour example £37.50
providers.included: Shared kitchen included, own food or caterer welcome, free parking and an adjacent outdoor play area.
providers.check: The kitchen may be shared with another hirer. Confirm set-up/clear-up time, the party layout and the exact booking total. This is near Exeter, not in the city centre.
providers.instagram_note: No official Instagram account confirmed on the reviewed hall and contact pages.

hire_facts.note: Published seating examples for the Main Hall, not a children's-play capacity. Confirm your party layout and booking limits. One-hour booking steps are not treated as proof of a one-hour minimum.
hire_facts.included: Shared kitchen included, own food or caterer welcome, free parking and an adjacent outdoor play area.
hire_facts.unknown_reason: Main Hall meeting/theatre example seats 100 and wedding-dining example seats 60. Neither is presented as a child-only party limit. No explicit minimum or maximum booking policy verified.

providers.name: Bow & Me Occasions
providers.basis: Delivery and venue set-up advertised
providers.included: Balloon displays, backdrop/prop combinations, light-up numbers and sweet-cart options.
providers.check: Ask whether pack-down, collection, delivery mileage and any venue-access requirements are included. Styling does not establish that food or children's activities are provided.
providers.instagram_note: Linked from the official supplier website.

providers.name: Annie’s Balloons
providers.basis: Set-up and take-down advertised
providers.included: Balloon arches, number displays, columns, table arches and backdrop hire.
providers.check: Confirm delivery coverage for your address, hire duration, collection and the final price.
providers.instagram_note: Linked from the official supplier website.

providers.name: Party Time Exeter
providers.basis: Specific listed decoration combination, not an all-in party quote
providers.included: The service list offers a backdrop, balloon garland and light-up number combination, alongside individual hire items.
providers.check: Confirm installation, delivery, collection, location restrictions, access times and booking terms for this exact product.
providers.instagram_note: Official Instagram handle not confirmed. A matching business name alone is not enough to tag.

providers.name: Confetti Events Devon
providers.basis: Delivery charges may apply; £75 non-refundable booking deposit advertised
providers.included: Bespoke displays, backdrops, welcome signage and picnic/table styling. Delivery, set-up and collection are advertised.
providers.check: Ask what the selected package includes and how the deposit applies to the quote. The separate picnic package starts at £195; it is not included in the backdrop starting price.
providers.instagram_note: Linked from the official supplier website.

providers.name: Blank Canvas Tent Hire
providers.basis: Travel charged separately; bespoke final quote
providers.included: Low pallet tables, rugs, cushions, décor, professional set-up and pack-down. Tableware is an upgrade; food and drink are not included.
providers.check: Confirm the number of guests covered, address-based travel cost, indoor/covered options and the time needed for installation and collection.
providers.instagram_note: Linked from the official supplier website.

providers.name: It’s Your Day
providers.basis: Dry hire is a separate DIY option
providers.included: Room decorations, balloons, backdrops, table linen and themed styling. Selected props are also offered on a supply-only basis.
providers.check: Confirm a child-appropriate brief, the items available, and whether you are buying a styling service or hiring items to install and return yourself.
providers.instagram_note: Linked from the official supplier website; original HTTP link normalised to HTTPS.

providers.name: Ozzy D
providers.basis: Price depends on the date, location and chosen service
providers.travel: Exeter and the South West; mileage quote needed
providers.included: Magic shows with options such as puppets, games, circus activities or balloon modelling. Agree exactly what your chosen show includes.
providers.check: Confirm set-up space, sound, guest numbers and travel costs. The FAQ requires two adults over 21 to remain present and lists a £50 non-refundable booking fee; request the current cancellation terms before paying. Entertainment is not childcare.
providers.instagram_note: Official Instagram not confirmed on the reviewed website and contact page. Do not tag a similar name.

providers.name: Mr Phil Parties
providers.basis: Two-hour entertainment package; Exeter included in the listed coverage
providers.travel: Exeter included; outside South Devon ask for a quote
providers.included: A hosted mix of magic, circus skills, music, games and plate spinning. Food and cake are supplied by the family, not the entertainer.
providers.check: Reconfirm the published total, available date and guest limit. Ask about set-up time, floor and ceiling space, venue access, and the adults who need to remain. The two-hour package does not include hall hire or food.
providers.instagram_note: No official Instagram link confirmed on the Exeter or home page. Website and Facebook presence alone do not establish an Instagram handle.

providers.name: Devon Science
providers.basis: 60-minute Crazy Chemistry party for up to 9 children; other group sizes and themes cost more
providers.included: Interactive experiments, equipment, set-up and tidy-down, plus the children’s creations and bags to take home. Other themes have different ages, times and prices.
providers.check: Ask for the mileage-inclusive total and confirm venue access, tables, water, clear-up, supervising adults and any activity-specific requirements. Allow the advertised 30 minutes for set-up within your hall booking. Venue hire and catering are not established as included.
providers.instagram_note: Account linked from the official Devon Science website. This does not confirm current availability or recent profile activity.

providers.name: Miss Sparkles
providers.basis: Two-hour minimum (£120 before any travel charge); current quote needed
providers.age: Age suitability TBC with the painter
providers.travel: Exeter covered; further travel fees may apply
providers.included: Face painting with the artist’s table, chair, equipment and design boards. The website estimates up to 25 faces in two hours; confirm what is realistic for your designs.
providers.check: The page has no current tariff date, so reconfirm price, travel and trading availability before relying on the guide. Ask about minimum ages, suitability, queue arrangements, design time and cancellations. Face painting is not a full-party hosting service.
providers.instagram_note: No official Instagram link confirmed on the reviewed service and home pages; handle left unverified.

providers.name: Meraki Art School
providers.area: Exeter studio · mobile visits by arrangement
providers.basis: Studio party prices are not a quote for delivery at your hall
providers.age: Studio mixed-media themes: 4–10; mobile suitability TBC
providers.duration: Mobile duration TBC; studio format is 2 hours
providers.travel: Off-site visits considered case by case; extra charge may apply
providers.booking_note: Mobile visits must be agreed directly
providers.included: An art activity with materials and a creation to take home. The school says it can sometimes come to your venue; the off-site format needs a separate agreement.
providers.check: Confirm mobile delivery to your postcode, minimum spend, group limit, workshop length, tables, surfaces, supervision and clean-up. The party page contains 2025 date and tariff references: do not assume its studio price or Sunday timetable is current or applies off-site. Food is not included in the studio package.
providers.instagram_note: Official website-linked account. Mobile party delivery and current rates must be agreed separately; the page includes older dates.
